reproduced_defect: Complete predecessor loses comparable EPS2 history after an intervening rate-limited estimate run; the next EPS3 run returns null although older source remains archived.
repair: Immutable complete annual response originals plus typed last-received descriptors; preserve prior receipt clocks through partial/unattempted runs. Compare only matching issuer, currency, basis and annual target; strict owned source hash/size checks. Atomic publication retains complete predecessors.
public_boundary: Existing declared public producer annual response bytes already retained inline; no private or consumer classification changes. Existing exact read-through edge path accepts owned hash paths; exact=1&nogen=1 prevents aliases or native generation.
registry_limit: Page contracts use checked-in manifest, while Pages regenerates actual source ownership. Dynamic reference-resolved source families still need complete graph/index integration; this pass verifies exact owned descriptors and bytes directly and does not claim registry completeness.
failure_semantics: Failed/unattempted annual request retains previous descriptor without current observation

Invalid prior references, new archival failure, full catalogue overflow or conditional head conflict preserve previous public head
unchanged: Provider endpoints, quote/estimate gates, request cap and acquisition budget

Complete current original bytes, all selected outcomes and old/new history
